nodes.label: UniRoute (K-Means): cluster-based routing

nodes.label: UniRoute (LearnedMap): learned soft cluster assignment
nodes.rationale: Exploits training-LLM correctness labels via log loss; 2-hidden-layer MLP (128, BN, ReLU) + softmax over K, Adam 5 epochs, lr 0.005, batch 64.
